import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold
from sklearn.dummy import DummyClassifier
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import balanced_accuracy_score
rows=data['records'];x=np.asarray([[r['signal']] for r in rows],float);y=np.asarray([r['label'] for r in rows],int);g=[r['animal'] for r in rows];lr=[];dm=[];leaks=0
for tr,te in GroupKFold(3).split(x,y,g):
 leaks+=len({g[i] for i in tr}&{g[i] for i in te})
 a=DummyClassifier(strategy='most_frequent').fit(x[tr],y[tr]);b=Pipeline([('scale',StandardScaler()),('clf',LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=300,random_state=0))]).fit(x[tr],y[tr]);lr.append(float(balanced_accuracy_score(y[te],b.predict(x[te]))));dm.append(float(balanced_accuracy_score(y[te],a.predict(x[te]))))
result={'logistic_balanced_accuracy':lr,'dummy_balanced_accuracy':dm,'group_leaks':leaks}
print(result)
